_doc: Interface and ownership registry for docs/harness/rebuild/. Convention: redesign/INTERFACES.md. harness.design rejects unknown keys, so this metadata cannot live in the .harness files. "cloud" = the harness.design cloud copy uploaded 2026-10-15 (K11 = A) so Dispatch can push updates later; the repo file stays the master.
_scope: The only center-cluster portion in this repo is the CAN node, plus power and ground to the cluster. Interior cluster wiring lives only in center-cluster-esp32-p4. Do not add interior cluster circuits here. ST185-CAN ends at its CAN-drop terminal t_cluster_can.

A-cabin.physical: ECU connector A to cabin firewall A: ECU-A, cabin half of bulkhead A, the A-pin relay coil (85) wires, broken off to the relays seated in the fuse box (ST185-CabinPower), APS, CSB3 plug, front wheel-speed spur (FL), A/C coolant switch branch, +5V / Gnd Out / +8V / switched-12V splices at ECU A

B-cabin.physical: ECU connector B to cabin firewall B: ECU-B, cabin half of bulkhead B, the B-pin relay coil (85) wires (k_fan2 / k_eps_en / k_acc in the fuse box, ST185-CabinPower), fuel level branch, rear wheel-speed spur, front wheel-speed FR core, the B legs of +5V / Gnd Out / switched 12V

CabinPower.physical: Cabin power (non-ECU): the two glove-box fuse + relay boxes (DECISIONS R75, cad/fusebox rev 7) - POWER box (tinned copper + bar that is the AMI bar, no 1/0 link cable, AMI IN relay feeds, AMI OUT, Mini ISO relays k_htr / k_efi / k_str / k_fan / k_fan2 / k_pwr, ACPS fuse) and LOGIC box (Bus 1 / Bus 2 mini fuses, micro relays k_hl / k_hr / k_horn / k_etb / k_acc / k_eps_en / k_rev), k_eps HCR150 beside them, battery feed ring; ECU coil wires from A-cabin / B-cabin and the A-cabin, B-cabin, A-engine, CSB3, CAN, AntiTheft, RearLights, HeavyDC and EngineRoom-C ends arrive broken off

A-engine.physical: Engine harness behind bulkhead A - every engine device whose ECU signal is on connector A

B-engine.physical: Engine harness behind bulkhead B - every engine device whose ECU signal is on connector B, and the ETB motor

HeavyDC.physical: Heavy DC chain (Route 1) - trunk battery, RADLOK firewall pair, starter, 160 A alternator B+, engine-bay jump post, engine block ground. Hands off to EngineRoom-C at the POWER box bus zone (breaks H1/H2/H3/H6a) - the POWER box bus zone itself, and everything else it feeds (cabin fuse block, glove-box body block, OEM hot, AM1/AM2), stays on EngineRoom-C. Also the battery relay block in the trunk (DECISIONS R75, passenger side between the rear wall and the battery): fed from the kill switch LOAD side, AMI-40 FP fuse and the fuel pump relay k_fp (HCR150); its coil wires arrive broken off from A-cabin (A19) and CabinPower (SW12), its output breaks off to RearFuel.

WheelSpeed-Rear.physical: Rear wheel-speed Y harness - RL/RR ABS drops to the rear VRC endpoints, one screened 4-core output to IX_WS_REAR

WheelSpeed-Front.physical: Front wheel-speed Y harness - FL/FR ABS drops (loom C fender route) to the front VRC endpoints, output pair to IX_WS_FRONT

RearFuel.physical: Rear Fuel - fuel level sender behind IX_FUEL_LVL, and the fuel pump with its trunk ground; the pump feed arrives broken off from k_fp in the battery relay block (HeavyDC)

CSB3.physical: ECUMaster CSB3 plug and switch inputs (cruise stalk, clutch, brake, cruise ladder) and the 8-channel brake / reverse optocoupler board inline at the plug; power, ground, reverse, LED and CAN wires arrive broken off

RearLights.physical: Rear lighting (Route 15): J/B No.1 1F tail / turn and S9 stop flying leads, the reverse feed broken off from k_rev (CabinPower), LH sill to R11 / R12 rear combination lamps, L1 license light, H6 high-mount stop light (hatch), one rear ground BL

pins.c4: FR out -> B21. Leaves the shield at this inline connector - continues cabin-side as its own short shielded spur on A-cabin/B-cabin, own drain, not drawn here.
pins.c6: spare, plugged. Was the FR cable's own drain when FL/FR were two separate output cables - superseded 2026-10-10, Route 9 rev 3.

pins.c1: +5V Out to B engine sensors via IX_B_RAIL - oil pressure
pins.c2: +5V Out to B engine sensors via IX_B_RAIL - fuel pressure
pins.c3: +5V Out to B engine sensors via IX_B_RAIL - coolant pressure

rear VR conditioner, IN_R input (RR sensor); harness side ends in the LP-16 plug lp16_vrc_r_in
rear VR conditioner, output; harness side ends in the LP-16 plug lp16_vrc_r_out
front VR conditioner, IN_L input (FL sensor); harness side ends in the LP-16 plug lp16_vrc_f_in
front VR conditioner, IN_R input (FR sensor); harness side ends in the LP-16 plug lp16_vrc_f_in
front VR conditioner, output; harness side ends in the LP-16 plug lp16_vrc_f_out

enclosures.note: Drain connected on both the VRC input and the VRC output, by pin: IN pin 3 (one sensor drain crimped in, the other T-spliced onto it behind the plug, DECISIONS S9) is wired to OUT pin 5 inside the box. No connector shell and no case bond (Daniel 2026-10-12). Grounded at the ECU.

Drain connected on both the VRC input and the VRC output, by pin: IN pin 3 (one sensor drain crimped in, the other T-spliced onto it behind the plug, DECISIONS S9) is wired to OUT pin 5 inside the box. No connector shell and no case bond (Daniel 2026-10-12). Grounded at the ECU.

physicalPartGroups._doc: Connector ids in different harness files that are the SAME physical connector (the DRB102 bulkhead: receptacle on A-cabin + B-cabin, plug on A-engine + B-engine). Each file draws the whole connector and marks the other files' cavities N/C (audit_shared_connectors.py). buylist.py counts the housing and its configuration hardware once per group. Lives here because harness.design rejects unknown connector keys.
